entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Our marksmanship lacks finesse.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, it's too... blunt.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell you talkin' about?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I had a thought while watching[n]"Doronko Billy" the other day.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Do you know what trick shooting is?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You mean like shooting a vase off[n]someone's head or a plate out of the air?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What's the point of doing that during[n]a real fight?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, I don't mean we should put on a[n]show or anything...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But maybe we should learn to shoot with[n]precision instead of just firing at enemies.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Not a bad idea, Lady Ann.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we improve our marksmanship,[n]we'll stand a better chance at hitting[n]an enemy's vitals.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Or, we can wound enemies in specific[n]ways.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Like immobilizing them, as opposed to[n]just doing damage.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We could keep them alive to lure out[n]a rescue team.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, when you put it that way, Ann[n]might be on to somethin'.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Good luck finding a way to up your[n]shootin' skills, [fName].
You're dumping this on me?
Why me?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I use a shotgun.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I use a submachine gun.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And I use an assault rifle.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You're the only one who uses a gun[n]that's good for trick shooting.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It'll be a useful skill for you, so let's see[n]if we can't find ways to improve your[n]marksmanship.
